The '''1921–22 Scottish Division One''' season was won by [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]] by one point over nearest rival [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]]. [[Dumbarton F.C.|Dumbarton]], [[Queen's Park F.C.|Queen's Park]] and [[Clydebank F.C. (1914)|Clydebank]] finished 20th and 21st and 22nd respectively and were relegated to the [[1922–23 Scottish Division Two]].
